Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, who need to know their duties after a crash and during a traffic stop.
Why it matters to a first-timer: after a crash a driver must stay, help and exchange information and should clear minor crashes from the lanes [A01], failing to stop carries long suspensions and revocations [A02], and a traffic stop goes safely when the driver follows a few clear steps [A03].
Level: practical recall of crash duties, a ladder of failure-to-stop penalties and the order of actions during a traffic stop.
Prerequisites: the emergency and crash-avoidance pages that precede this section.
